column2: a server-direction Session::Binding from the client is a framing violation: connection-fatal FRAME_ERROR (0x201)
a second capabilities frame after negotiation: connection-fatal FRAME_ERROR (0x201)
a capabilities frame with the response flag set as the first frame (server-direction before negotiation): connection-fatal FRAME_ERROR (0x201)
request IDs must increase from 1: repeated or decreasing IDs are connection-fatal FRAME_ERROR (0x201)
a control FIN before detach is outside the Section 12.8 MAY: connection-fatal FRAME_ERROR (0x201) (normative-clarifications-review item 5)

stream-count ceilings are transport parameters (normative-clarifications-review item 4): the second client bidirectional stream is refused at QUIC transport level (the open blocks past the budget deadline); the row never waits for an application LIMIT_EXCEEDED frame

more concurrent unidirectional streams than the negotiated data geometry are likewise refused at transport level; after the held streams are reset the credit is released and a replacement open succeeds
